Implement ADR D7. For each symbol on the explicit public-symbol list, write a curated Markdown contract: purpose, parameters, return semantics, errors, examples and compatibility notes.

Docstrings at the pinned SHA are source material to select from and validate against current behaviour. Do not copy them wholesale, and never archive removed prose.

If D7 chose a drift tool, wire it as a CI check that compares the authored contracts with the released wheel's signatures and types, importing only the listed symbols in an isolated pinned environment.

Every current reference URL and anchor serves the new page or a listed redirect page. Update the api-docs lane contract to the new outputs.

Delete the 27 autodoc .rst files in this item's PR, once their replacements exist. Rendered output changes, so use the astro-site-03 visual procedure. Do not add docstrings to code.
